svg.title: Recommended Loop skill toolkits
svg.desc: Role-specific recommendations. Skills are optional instructions, not a sandbox.

g.text: Choose a focused toolkit for your work
Recommendations, not mandatory sequences. Run only the skills your task needs.
Professional developer
Core: loop-research-repo, loop-code, loop-debug, loop-test, loop-review
Optional: loop-plan, loop-workflow-pr
DO: Choose code for new behavior or debug for a demonstrated defect.
DO NOT: Run every installed skill for every change.
Project builder
Core: loop-workflow-project, loop-plan, loop-code, loop-test, loop-handoff
Optional: loop-context, loop-review
DO: Keep non-goals and undecided product choices visible.
DO NOT: Treat a generated scaffold as a finished product.
Maintainer and QA engineer
Core: loop-test-adversarial, loop-evaluate, loop-ci, loop-review
Optional: loop-workflow-pr, loop-test-compatibility
DO: Freeze the expected outcome before grading outputs.
DO NOT: Change the oracle to make a failed case pass.
Researcher
Core: loop-research, loop-context, loop-evaluate
Optional: loop-research-repo, loop-research-tools, loop-handoff
DO: Record source dates and distinguish evidence from inference.
DO NOT: Treat a paper result as proof of this repository's runtime behavior.
Incident responder
Core: loop-workflow-incident, loop-diagnose, loop-observe
Optional: loop-deploy, loop-security
DO: Prefer reversible actions inside existing authorization.
DO NOT: Treat one green probe as sustained recovery.
